Question Choices: Multiply 3 1/2 x 1 3/7. Write the result as mixed number
Hints: Convert mixed numbers to improper fractions, multiply numerators and denominators, then simplify.
Solution: 3 1/2 x 1 3/7 = (7/2) x (10/7) = 70/14. Divide numerator and denominator by 14: 70/14 = 5. Simplified result: 5.
